intro: Mennet Carkad is an introductory rogue quest in the Undercity that brings promising operatives into the fold of the Deathstalkers. Directed by Marion Call, aspiring assassins are summoned to report directly to Mennet Carkad deep within the Rogues' Quarter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?
Either way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm. No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.
